statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH; Tail is in the watch band while Stress remains extreme.
recommendation: WATCH is the mapped policy state. Stronger Tail classification remains conditional on observed persistent NQ extension and failed retracements.
headline: WATCH Tail as overnight NQ weakens; extreme macro and energy stress persists
body: The latest delayed NQ reference retrieved was around 29,393, about 0.19% below the prior close and near the overnight low. The move shows weakness but not enough verified failed-retracement structure for a 25%+ Tail state. Brent was $101.34 at 01:07 UTC, while the 10-year yield had recently reached 4.8528%. Shared Finviz context was stale and excluded.

lookbackSummary: The prior 24 hours moved from overnight trend-up/WATCH through a severe U.S.-session downside Tail episode, then normalized to mixed low-Tail conditions by the overnight session.
outlookSummary: Tail remains WATCH ahead of PPI, claims and the U.S. open. Forecast escalation is conditional on observed persistent extension, shallow pullbacks, session-extreme holding and aligned cross-asset confirmation.

forecastDetail.comment: Current delayed NQ evidence shows weakness near the overnight low without proof of repeated failed retracements; WATCH is consistent with the richer hourly analysis.
Late-Asia structure is the checkpoint: stabilization lowers Tail, while renewed extension with shallow rebounds preserves WATCH.
Pre-Europe liquidity can exaggerate moves; the published score requires a sustained overnight-low break before stronger Tail is justified.
Europe is approaching with oil and rates still stressful, but the forecast remains conditional on NQ failing to recover.
